email.subject: Interview times for the Product Designer role
email.body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for sending over your portfolio. The team loved the case study on the booking flow, and we'd like you to meet our design lead for a 45-minute interview.

Would any of these times next week work for you?
• Tuesday at 10:00 am
• Wednesday at 1:30 pm
• Friday at 11:00 am

If none of them do, send me a couple of times that suit you and I'll make it happen.

Best,
Maya Chen
Recruiting, Harbor Labs
